scenes.text: Imagine standing in a mysterious fifty square mile strip of beautiful land deep inside Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically commit a major crime and never face a trial.
Known as the Zone of Death, this area exploits a bizarre constitutional loophole because the Sixth Amendment guarantees you a jury from the state and district where the crime occurred.
While this entire federal district legally belongs to Wyoming, this specific uninhabited strip of the park actually sits in Idaho, meaning a legal jury can never physically be formed.
Even though Congress has known about this terrifying loophole for decades, they still have not fixed it, so would you ever dare to camp here? Comment below and follow for more!
